You know that friend who won't stop talking about their Pilates class?

It's easy to roll your eyes, right up until you notice they actually look forward to exercising, while you're still stuck in the same old routine.

Studio Glide is now open on Station Road East. Small classes, expert instructors and an intro pack worth passing on: 3 classes for £29.

Book yours and see what they keep going on about.
ads.headline: Your friend was right

Nervous about starting something new? Hear it from people who felt the same.

Any studio can tell you it's great. It means more coming from members who were once complete novices, anxious about turning up and convinced exercise wasn't for them.

Studio Glide is rated 5.0 on Google, and our members say it better than we can. Swipe to see why.

Now open in Oxted. New members start with 3 classes for £29.
